calculation.description: Contrarian five-session asset return, amplified when the observation-only DXY has experienced a large absolute five-session move. DXY is used only as a macro conditioning signal; no order is submitted for it. Values at date t use data through t and predict forward returns after t.

validation.regime_notes: Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC over the 15 tradable benchmark instruments; the reduced date count reflects DXY availability. Admission thresholds are absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840. Interpret uncertainty conservatively due to the small cross-section.
